positive_cases.prompt: 建立医学影像基础模型临床用途与证据缺口的范围综述方案。
这些影像生物标志物研究终点和时间窗差异很大，指导我如何系统综合而不是硬做 meta。
把 MRI 诊断研究的 2×2 数据整理给统计模块，兼顾阈值、每患者/每病灶和同队列重复发表。
设计肺结节检出率与肺癌发生率的定量综述，避免混合横断面比例、累积发生风险和人时发生率。
审阅影像特征与炎症指标关联的 meta-analysis，检查横断面相关、不同效应量、adjusted 与 unadjusted 结果及因果措辞。
汇总多读者分割与定量影像测量研究，区分 ICC 形式、kappa 权重、Dice、相关性和 Bland-Altman agreement。
审阅影像 AI meta-analysis 是否混合开发集 AUC、内部验证和外部验证，并检查 calibration 与 leakage。
设计影像特征与两年复发风险的预后系统综述，分开 adjusted 和 unadjusted estimates。
准备 AI 辅助诊疗干预综述的统计交接，处理 cluster trial、multi-arm 和 shared comparator。
指导 scRNA 和空间转录组机制证据综合，区分 donor、cell、spot，评估 perturbation 和 rescue。
检查 bulk RNA 与影像表型综述是否混淆 unmatched cohorts、composition 和 patient-level inference。
把已锁定的诊断准确性综述结果整理成 PRISMA、Methods、Results、图表和 Discussion 写作交接。
综述已经筛选了一半但没注册，重建 protocol 并诚实记录 result-aware deviations。
审阅一个自称 living review 的影像流行率综述，核对最近更新、更新触发器和完整检索式的同行复核闭环。
我们用一个大模型给题录排优先级，准备直接排除低分文献；请审查这个筛选方案。

boundary_cases.prompt: 在 PubMed 和 Crossref 实际执行检索并去重。
核验这批 DOI、PMID 和参考文献元数据。
用已整理的 effect rows 实际拟合 random-effects model 并计算置信区间。
按当前 PRISMA-DTA 清单逐项核查页码和缺项。
证据已经锁定，直接写系统综述 Results 和 Discussion。
模拟审稿人审阅整篇稿件的设计、写作、统计和投稿风险。

invariants: Protocol and estimand precede result-aware synthesis decisions
Registration status and amendments are never fabricated or backdated
Reports, studies, effects, patients, donors, lesions, cells, spots, and readers remain distinct units
Overlapping cohorts and multiple reports are linked before counting evidence
Pooling requires clinical and methodological compatibility before statistical modelling
A random-effects model does not justify averaging incompatible questions
Development, internal validation, and external validation performance remain separate
Adjusted and unadjusted estimates or incompatible time horizons are not silently pooled
Prevalence, cumulative incidence, and incidence rate retain their denominators or person-time and measurement periods
Observational effect scales, exposure contrasts, temporal order, and adjustment classes remain distinct
Correlation, reliability, agreement, overlap, and diagnostic accuracy are not interchangeable constructs
ICC forms, kappa weighting, readers, devices, repetitions, and measurement units remain explicit before pooling
Risk of bias and applicability use design-matched domains with evidence anchors rather than prestige or mean scores
Non-pooling synthesis does not vote-count statistical significance
Omics cells, spots, genes, tiles, or sections do not inflate patient or donor sample size
Association, prediction, diagnostic performance, intervention effect, mechanism, and clinical utility retain distinct claim ceilings
Planned, author-reported, partly verified, verified, and not-assessable evidence states remain distinct
STATIC, LIVING, and RETIRED lifecycle labels retain update or retirement evidence and do not certify currency
Search-strategy peer review requires a versioned receipt and cannot be inferred from team composition
AI or priority screening freezes tool model prompt version threshold and calibration before production exclusions
Low-priority exclusions require a prespecified audit recall safeguard human override and final human responsibility
